mt.faq.title: Marketing <red>questions</red>
mt.faq.sub: What you get and how to start, in plain words.
mt.faq.1.q: What marketing support do I get?
mt.faq.1.a: Ready-made banners, landing pages and videos, free TradingView charts, real-time trading signals to share with your audience, the White-Label Academy and a dedicated partner manager.
mt.faq.2.q: How do I become a TradeQuo IB?
mt.faq.2.a: Open and verify a TradeQuo account, apply to the IB program in your Client Portal, and start sharing your referral link once you’re approved. We review applications within 24 hours.
mt.faq.3.q: Do I need experience or capital?
mt.faq.3.a: No. There’s no joining fee, and you don’t need capital or trading experience. A verified TradeQuo account is all it takes.
mt.faq.4.q: When and how do I get paid?
mt.faq.4.a: Every day. Commissions settle at 00:00 server time, and we cover processing and withdrawal fees. Minimum thresholds and supported payout methods are listed in the payout calendar.
